MeasurementSession.title: MeasurementSession
MeasurementSession.description: A 3-trial stopwatch and flow rate measurement session owned by an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique Firestore document ID scoped to the owner.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

label.description: Display label of the measurement session.

category.description: Measurement category (e.g., Diga Sud, Diga Nord, Flusso).

notes.description: Optional user notes for the measurement session.

containerAmount.description: Container volume in liters (0 if not set).

flowRatePerSec.description: Calculated flow rate in liters per second.

flowRatePerMin.description: Calculated flow rate in liters per 60 seconds.

flowRatePerHour.description: Calculated flow rate in liters per 60 minutes.

flowRatePer24Hours.description: Calculated flow rate in liters per 24 hours.

time1.description: First trial time in milliseconds (0 if not recorded).

time2.description: Second trial time in milliseconds (0 if not recorded).

time3.description: Third trial time in milliseconds (0 if not recorded).

averageAfterStop1.description: Running average after first stop in milliseconds.

averageAfterStop2.description: Running average after second stop in milliseconds.

averageAfterStop3.description: Running average after third stop in milliseconds.

minTime.description: Minimum recorded trial time in milliseconds.

maxTime.description: Maximum recorded trial time in milliseconds.

recordedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the measurement was recorded.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud document was last updated.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Cloud-synced stopwatch and flow rate measurement sessions scoped per authenticated user via ownerId.
